provenance.kept_fields: Receipt logs are kept whole. Of each receipt only the block, transaction and status fields are kept.
provenance.constructed: Nothing before the migration blocks is captured. The endpoint has no public history before block 15,500,000, so the seam constructs one legacy-controller NameRenewed per name in the block before its migration block. It carries the name, a zero cost and the expiry the name's ENSv2 LabelRegistered carries. That renewal is the first registrar event bigname sees for the name, so it opens a lease with no known holder.
